verdict.rationale: Braintrust ships an official `bt` CLI with its own quickstart and reference docs. It covers authentication, tracing coding-agent sessions, running evals, browsing and querying logs (`bt view logs`), syncing data (`bt sync pull`) and managing functions. The docs frame it explicitly for setting up and running Braintrust with your coding agent, which matches the AI-native framing of the story. The SDK repo also shows `npx braintrust eval` for running evals from the command line. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI in agent-driven workflows.
